extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi caches configurable movie and TV M3U catalogues, provides fast indexed browsing, unified search, recently played/resume lists, lightweight metadata and external FFmpeg download-script generation.
extension.news: 0.7.6 - Replace device-side downloads with external FFmpeg scripts, expand metadata status, make playback pausing and bulk confirmation configurable, and surface IMDb rating, director and cast in browse descriptions.
